'''Agarabi''', also called '''Bare''', is a [[Kainantu language]] spoken in [[Agarabi Rural LLG]], [[Eastern Highlands Province]], [[Papua New Guinea]].

* Sounds {{IPA|/p, t, k, w/}} may fluctuate to fricative sounds {{IPA|[ɸ, s, x, β]}} when between oral vowels.
* Sounds {{IPA|/p, t/}} may also be heard as voiced {{IPA|[b, d]}} within complex syllable nuclei.
* {{IPA|/n/}} may be heard as {{IPA|[ŋ]}} when before {{IPA|/k/}}.
* {{IPA|/r/}} can be heard as either a tap {{IPA|[ɾ]}} or a trill {{IPA|[r]}}.
* {{IPA|/ʔ/}} may occasionally fluctuate to a fricative {{IPA|[h]}}.
